claims.assertion: Yazhi claimed Queen Elizabeth was reptilian and said such beings project a human appearance through mind and technology; she speculated the Queen had changed bodies.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She said she was not fully certain.

claims.assertion: Yazhi predicted gradual losses of freedom, including limits on ownership and expiring income, and described them as a Cabal plan.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: Yazhi said Hashmallim missions are limited to influencing selected individuals and may involve human disguises; she said the Queen mainly decides their missions.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

review_flags: Reptilian claims about a public figure are attributed to Yazhi and not independently verified.
